fit: Uncentered SVD of8 discovery donor-minus-recipient rawpreMLP4 contrasts per task, one orientation/pair. All8 ranks possible. No transfer differences or effects used in fitting. Rank1/2/4/8 frozen before evaluation.
scope: Supervised task-contrast compression, not unsupervised featurizer/manifold discovery. H847 selected layer/position using both formats, so transfer split is held out from basis fit but not fresh research confirmation.
controls: Full rawdonor, identity, own-task projection, own orthogonal complement, other-task projection, three Gaussian random subspace projections, three random directions scaled to own-projection norm (each both signs). Fixed independent random seed848.
evaluation: All31 aligned pairs, both directions. Patch recipient rawstate + projected donor-minus-recipient difference at single H847 relay position; keep rest native. Record individual margin fidelity and KL(full swap||approx), not just positive answer transfer. Different tasks use same1152-dimensional preMLP4 coordinate system.
